confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Penang price levels for July 2026; no live menus, booking pages, or listings were checked. Restaurant and hostel anchors are moderately reliable; hotel rates are least certain because weekend and seasonal demand can move them widely. Cocktail and wine anchors are weaker and were set from the beer anchor, with cocktails and wine glasses at roughly 2.2 to 2.6 times beer. Alcohol anchors assume licensed venues, since some Penang eateries do not serve alcohol.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Penang was placed as a mid-cost Malaysian heritage tourist city, generally below Kuala Lumpur, with lodging and dining levels roughly in line with other mid-sized Malaysian tourist destinations such as Melaka.
